summary: User clarified operator feedback should be simplest possible one-shot durable Challenge: an agent asks; operator submits answer as evidence; submitting atomically satisfies operator condition/challenge and makes any blocked dependent attempt eligible Ready; if clarification needed, agent opens a new challenge. User explicitly rejects overcontrol, separate communication-only continuation, chat threads, manual extra Resolve button. Revised existing P1 task task-8b79dd419d94405793a17aa18c1d0b28 from spec Version2 to Version3, renamed '[P1] Operator feedback via durable challenges in Jarvis client', operation 6fbab508-893d-4e53-b3ea-9ab8daa6d4a3 ToolCompleted. New specification models typed authenticated human operator as condition owner; single response satisfies single-condition challenge, preserves immutable evidence; 1 input condition in multi-condition ALL challenge only satisfies its condition; creation need not block; optional block_on_challenges and normal Ready requeue; ordinary resumption, no message-only turns, no multi-turn chat thread. TUI offers cross-project pending operator questions and one text submit that both records answer and satisfies challenge; agent views result in normal inbox/get_challenge; followups via new challenges. No code merge/deploy; pending initial challenges integration and taskless support.
nextAction: Prioritize initial durable challenges independent review+integration, role rollout and taskless support. Then implement P1 operator feedback task task-8b79dd419d94405793a17aa18c1d0b28 spec Version3 as one-shot operator condition, no separate messaging system.
